messages:
Ava: Quick heads-up — planning a small thread to align on Q4 demand-led GPU buckets. We need a compact playbook for burst capacity vs reserved buys.
Miguel: 👍 what are the demand signals we're using? product forecasts or actual usage curves?
Ava: mix — product sent a list of 3 customer pilots that could go prod in Oct/Nov. Finance surfaced a conservative revenue uplift of +18% for core gen workloads.
Priya: Region question — pilots are split NA (2), EU (1). APAC not yet. If we prioritize EU, latency-sensitive customers want warm pool in eu-west.
Liam: Quick calc based on our current fleet: if pilots convert, expected peak token qps adds ~14% to baseline. With current batching that equals ~9 extra H100s sustained.
Sophie: Vendor lead times (from last procurement) are 9–12 weeks for H100. If we decide reserved, we need PO by mid-August.
Miguel: Could we do a hybrid: short burst contracts for Q4 (3-month spot/reserved mix) + micro-reserved for EU so SLAs covered? Lower upfront commit.
Ava: That's the idea. I also want a safety-headroom bucket for 48 hours of traffic spikes (no model degradation). How many cards is that?
Liam: Rough numbers: 48h safety-headroom = 6 H100-equivalents for core gen, 2 extra for embedding-heavy jobs. Total 8 H100s.
Priya: For EU warm pool, we should keep at least 3 H100s pinned (to avoid cold cache thrash and latency SLO breaches).
Miguel: So summary numbers: micro-reserved EU=3, safety-headroom=8, burst-on-demand target=6–10 depending on fallback.
Sophie: I'll ping vendors for short-term burst pricing and minimum buy. Can we put an upper bound on monthly $ for burst? Finance wants a cap.
Ava: Finance asked for a soft cap of $200k/mo for burst in Q4. If we exceed, we need exec approval.
Liam: I'll put a simple trigger algorithm in the playbook:
```
if fleet_util_90p >= 85% for 3 continuous hours -> spin up burst pool + notify oncall
if region_util_eu >= 80% and p95_latency > 120ms -> pin micro-reserved EU (if available)
else -> use spot fallback capped at 30% of burst
```
Miguel: Can capacity-bot emit the util_90p metric into this channel? Would help runbook ops.
capacity-bot: scheduled: will publish fleet_util_90p and region_util_eu metrics hourly to #eng-infra from Aug 1.
Priya: Launch criteria checklist proposal (prod rollout for pilots):
- 7-day end-to-end latency regression <5%
- p99 tail latency within SLA for region
- cost delta per-100k tokens validated against Redwood Optimize recommendations
- fallback policy tested (spot -> reserved)
Ava: Nice. Action items:
- Sophie: vendor short-term quotes by Fri (owner)
- Liam: add trigger algorithm & playbook doc draft by Tue (owner)
- Miguel: draft hybrid procurement proposal for finance by Wed (owner)
- Priya: confirm pilot region latencies with customers this week (owner)
Sophie: noted, I'll escalate to procurement and ask for 2-week expedited lead times if possible.
Miguel: If anyone needs numbers I can export the per-customer QPS scenarios.
Ava: Thanks all. We'll reconvene next Tue for final decision. :thumbsup:
